name: Kikenbi Neratte!? Haramase Oukoku
original_name: 危険日狙って!? 孕ませ王国
source:
There was once a faraway land.
Born a lowly vagrant, the protagonist hid away in the streets of squalor. One day a royal parade passed, and with it the beautiful princess Celena. Inspired, he became a servant of the castle, but was in the dungeons. Then another beautiful girl offered him a chance to work in the house of nobles...

And with that first step was born the man (still you!) who would shake the world. The king of pregnancy. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE083422.html]DLsite English[/url]]
